column2: Announcing the mana left in a pool after paying a cost is a communication procedure between players; the engine keeps every mana pool as public game state (Player::mana_pool), so there is nothing to execute.
Announcing unspent mana when passing priority is a communication procedure between players; the engine keeps every mana pool as public game state (Player::mana_pool), so there is nothing to execute.
The tombstone icon is a printed frame marker that "has no effect on game play"; card data carries no such characteristic and nothing in the engine can observe it.
The Future Sight type icon is a printed frame marker that "has no effect on game play"; card types come from the type line, so there is no engine behavior to test.
